sections.title: List of taxes and charges in Denmark

rows.label: Personal income tax (bundskat, mellemskat, topskat, toptopskat) [national]
rows.value: Bundskat 12.01%; mellemskat 7.5% above DKK 641,200; topskat 7.5% above DKK 777,900; toptopskat 5% above DKK 2,592,700; personal allowance DKK 54,100; tax ceiling 44.57%. Paid by resident individuals. Personskatteloven §§ 6 to 10 and 19.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i lov om indkomstskat for personer m.v. (personskatteloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 23-10-2026)

rows.label: Labour-market contribution (AM-bidrag), a surcharge on earned income [national]
rows.value: 8% of pay and business profit, before income tax. Paid by employees (withheld by the employer) and the self-employed. Arbejdsmarkedsbidragsloven § 1.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Am-bidrag (arbejdsmarkedsbidrag); Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i arbejdsmarkedsbidragsloven (page dated 27-08-2026)

rows.label: Municipal income tax (kommuneskat) [municipal]
rows.value: National average 25.049% in 2026; set by each of the 98 municipalities (see the regional pages). Paid by resident individuals. Rates set by each municipality, published by Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Kommuneskatter - gennemsnitsprocenten i 2026 (dated 27-10-2025)

rows.label: Church tax (kirkeskat) [municipal]
rows.value: National average 0.867% for members of the Church of Denmark; set by each municipality. Paid by members of the Church of Denmark. Rates set by each municipality, published by Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Kommuneskatter - gennemsnitsprocenten i 2026 (dated 27-10-2025)

rows.label: Capital gains on shares (aktieindkomst) [national]
rows.value: 27% on share income up to DKK 79,400 and 42% above. Paid by individuals with dividends and share gains. Personskatteloven § 8 a.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i lov om indkomstskat for personer m.v. (personskatteloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 23-10-2026)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (udbytteskat, kildeskat) [national]
rows.value: Dividends 27% (44% to listed countries, 15% reduced rate; 22% to companies); royalties 22%; interest to certain related companies 22%. Paid by recipients (withheld by the paying company). Kildeskatteloven §§ 2, 65, 65 C and 65 D; selskabsskatteloven § 2.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i kildeskatteloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 14-09-2026)

rows.label: Rental income (lejeindtægt): tax-free allowances [national]
rows.value: Holiday homes DKK 13,800 (DKK 50,200 if reported by a third party); part-year letting of the home DKK 13,800 (DKK 35,100); rooms at least DKK 24,000; the rest is taxable income. Paid by individuals who let property. Ligningsloven §§ 15 O, 15 P and 15 Q.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i ligningsloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 18-11-2026)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (begrænset skattepligt) [national]
rows.value: 25% in place of kommuneskat (PSL § 8 c); hired-out workers 30% gross plus 8% AM-bidrag; cross-border worker rules at 75% of income. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Kildeskatteloven §§ 2, 5 A and 48 B; personskatteloven § 8 c.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Du bor i udlandet og arbejder i Danmark

rows.label: Social security contributions (ATP and AM-bidrag) [national]
rows.value: ATP DKK 99 employee + DKK 198 employer a month at 117 hours or more; AM-bidrag 8%. Paid by employees and employers. ATP-loven; arbejdsmarkedsbidragsloven.

source.title: ATP Livslang Pension on Virk: Gældende satser for ATP-bidrag (opdateret 12.10.2026)

rows.label: Payroll tax (lønsumsafgift) [national]
rows.value: 15.3% of payroll for financial businesses; 6.37% for associations and some public businesses; 4.12% of payroll plus profit for other liable businesses. Paid by businesses with VAT-exempt activities. Lønsumsafgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om afgift af lønsum m.v. (lønsumsafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-05-2026)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (AM-bidrag on business profit) [national]
rows.value: 8% of business profit, paid as B-tax. Paid by the self-employed. Arbejdsmarkedsbidragsloven.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Am-bidrag (arbejdsmarkedsbidrag); Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i arbejdsmarkedsbidragsloven (page dated 27-08-2026)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: the overall assessment (lønmodtager eller selvstændig) [national]
rows.value: The self-employed pay their own tax and AM-bidrag as B-tax; 30% gross tax plus 8% AM-bidrag on foreign hired-out workers; fees to owners of 25% or more are A-income. Paid by the contractor (B-tax); Danish businesses hiring workers from abroad. Den juridiske vejledning C.C.1.2.1; kildeskatteloven §§ 43 and 48 B.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen, Den juridiske vejledning: C.C.1.2.1 Selvstændig erhvervsvirksomhed, afgrænsning over for lønmodtagere

rows.label: Occupational pension: ATP (labour-market supplementary pension) [national]
rows.value: Fixed amounts by hours worked: DKK 297 a month in total at 117 hours or more (one third employee, two thirds employer). Paid by employees and employers. Lov om Arbejdsmarkedets Tillægspension.

source.title: ATP Livslang Pension on Virk: Gældende satser for ATP-bidrag (opdateret 12.10.2026)

rows.label: Corporate income tax (selskabsskat) [national]
rows.value: 22%; 26% effective for financial companies; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies. Selskabsskatteloven § 17; minimumsbeskatningsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i selskabsskatteloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 02-09-2026)

rows.label: Local business tax: commercial property levy (dækningsafgift) [municipal]
rows.value: Up to 10 per mille of a commercial property's value, set by each municipality. Paid by owners of commercial property. Ejendomsskatteloven § 29.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i ejendomsskatteloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 27-08-2026)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: none for income tax (virksomhedsordningen only defers tax) [national]
rows.value: No flat-rate or turnover tax; profit kept in the business taxed provisionally at 22%; VAT registration from DKK 50,000 turnover. Paid by the self-employed (optional schemes). Virksomhedsskatteloven; momsloven (registration threshold).

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i lov om indkomstbeskatning af selvstændige erhvervsdrivende (virksomhedsskatteloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 03-09-2026)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits (udbytteskat) and branches of foreign companies [national]
rows.value: 27% dividend tax (22% for company shareholders); branches taxed at the 22% corporate rate. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); foreign companies with a Danish branch. Kildeskatteloven § 65; selskabsskatteloven § 21.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i kildeskatteloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 14-09-2026)

rows.label: Value added tax (moms) [national]
rows.value: 25% standard rate, no reduced rates; registration from DKK 50,000 annual turnover. Paid by consumers (collected by registered businesses). Momsloven § 33 (rate) and the registration thresholds.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser og beløbsgrænser i momsloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 02-09-2026)

rows.label: Excise duties (punktafgifter) on tobacco, alcohol, fuel and sugar [national]
rows.value: Cigarettes 193.54 øre each + 1% of retail price; spirits DKK 150 per litre of pure alcohol; petrol 361.9 øre per litre; chocolate DKK 25.97 per kg. Paid by consumers (paid by producers and importers). Tobaksafgiftsloven, spiritusafgiftsloven, mineralolieafgiftsloven, chokoladeafgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om tobaksafgifter (tobaksafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-05-2026)

rows.label: Insurance premium tax (skadesforsikringsafgift) [national]
rows.value: 1.1% of non-life insurance premiums. Paid by policyholders (collected by insurers). Skadesforsikringsafgiftsloven § 2.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om afgift af skadesforsikringer (skadesforsikringsafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-05-2026)

rows.label: Electricity tax (elafgift) [national]
rows.value: 0.8 øre per kWh in 2026 and 2027 (temporarily cut from 72.7 øre). Paid by electricity consumers. Elafgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om afgift af elektricitet (elafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-06-2026)

rows.label: Property tax: land tax (grundskyld) and property value tax (ejendomsværdiskat) [national and municipal]
rows.value: Land tax set by each municipality up to 30 per mille (3.1 to 17.7 per mille in 2026); property value tax 5.1 per mille, 14 per mille above DKK 9,007,000; base 80% of the valuation. Paid by property owners. Ejendomsskatteloven §§ 13, 22 and 28.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i ejendomsskatteloven, 2026 and 2027 (page dated 27-08-2026)

rows.label: Property transfer: registration duty (tinglysningsafgift) [national]
rows.value: 0.6% of the price + DKK 1,850 for a change of ownership; 1.25% + DKK 1,825 for a mortgage. Paid by the buyer (and the borrower for mortgages). Tinglysningsafgiftsloven §§ 4 and 5.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om afgift af tinglysning af ejer- og panterettigheder m.v. (tinglysningsafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-05-2026)

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (boafgift, gaveafgift) [national]
rows.value: 15% above DKK 392,300 for close relatives, plus 25% for others; gifts 15% above DKK 80,600 (36.25% to step-parents and grandparents); spouses exempt. Paid by estates and gift recipients. Boafgiftsloven §§ 1, 6, 22 and 23.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Satser og beløbsgrænser i lov om afgift af dødsboer og gaver (boafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 27-08-2026)

rows.label: Vehicle tax: registration tax (registreringsafgift) and annual owner tax [national]
rows.value: 25% / 85% / 150% of the taxable value of a new car plus a CO2 supplement; annual green owner tax by fuel consumption. Paid by vehicle buyers and owners. Registreringsafgiftsloven; brændstofforbrugsafgiftsloven; vægtafgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Gældende satser for registreringsafgiften (registreringsafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 02-09-2026)

rows.label: Carbon tax (CO2-afgift) [national]
rows.value: 194.2 øre per Nm³ of natural gas; DKK 860.3 per tonne of CO2 from waste (2026). Paid by fuel consumers (paid by suppliers). CO2-afgiftsloven.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om kuldioxidafgift af visse energiprodukter (CO2-afgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 23-09-2026)

rows.label: Air passenger tax (passagerafgift) [national]
rows.value: DKK 30 (Europe), DKK 260 (medium-haul) or DKK 320 (long-haul) per departing passenger in 2026. Paid by airlines (passed on to passengers). Lov om passagerafgift på flyrejser.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Passagerafgift på flyrejser

rows.label: Customs: EU customs duty, import VAT, handling fee and traveller allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: EUR 3 per item category on parcels up to EUR 150 (from 1 July 2026); EUR 2 handling fee (from 1 November 2026); 25% import VAT; allowances DKK 3,250 (air and sea) and DKK 2,250. Paid by importers and travellers. EU Customs Code; toldloven; momsloven.

source.title: Toldstyrelsen (toldst.dk): Internethandel uden for EU

rows.label: Stamp duty on documents: tinglysningsafgift on deeds, mortgages and other rights [national]
rows.value: DKK 1,850 fixed plus a percentage for deeds (0.6%) and charges (1.25% to 1.5%). Paid by the party registering the document. Tinglysningsafgiftsloven §§ 4 to 7.

source.title: Skatte- og Vækstministeriet: Afgiftssatser i lov om afgift af tinglysning af ejer- og panterettigheder m.v. (tinglysningsafgiftsloven), 2026 and 2027 (page dated 22-05-2026)

rows.label: Expat regime: researcher and high-earner scheme (forskerskatteordningen) [national]
rows.value: 27% gross tax plus 8% AM-bidrag (32.84%) for up to 7 years; monthly salary of at least DKK 65,400 in 2026. Paid by incoming researchers and key employees. Kildeskatteloven §§ 48 E and 48 F.

source.title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Forskerskatteordningen

rows.label: Wealth tax: none since 1997 (formueskat) [national]
rows.value: None since the 1997 income year: the wealth tax (1.0% until 1995, 0.7% in 1996 above DKK 2.4 million for single people and DKK 4.8 million for married couples) was abolished under the agreement on the 1996 Finance Act. Paid by no one. Repealed with effect from the 1997 income year (Skatteministeriet, Skatteberegningsreglerne for personer – før og nu, section 5.5.6).

rows.value: None: municipalities have no legal basis to levy a tourist tax on overnight stays; parliamentary motion B 52 of 14 November 2024 asks the government to propose a law creating one. Paid by no one. Folketinget, 2024/1 BSF 52.
rows.note: Checklist item F3

rows.value: None since 1 January 2022: chapter 10 of the Radio and Television Broadcasting Act (the media licence) was repealed, and DR is financed by a state grant. Paid by no one. Lov nr. 1548 af 18. december 2018, § 1 nr. 2 and 4, § 8.

rows.label: Wealth tax: none since 1997 (formueskat) [national]
rows.value: None since the 1997 income year: the wealth tax (1.0% until 1995, 0.7% in 1996 above DKK 2.4 million for single people and DKK 4.8 million for married couples) was abolished under the agreement on the 1996 Finance Act.
